_comment: 第三方 skill 锁定清单。fetch-deps.sh 按 commit 精确拉取到 ~/.taotao/vendor/<name>/；升级用 scripts/bump-deps.sh。

deps.name: superpowers
deps.used_for: brainstorming / writing-plans / subagent-driven-development / executing-plans / test-driven-development / systematic-debugging / requesting-code-review / verification-before-completion / using-git-worktrees / finishing-a-development-branch
deps._why_not_exposed: 它的 using-superpowers 与 brainstorming 会自动接管所有开发任务，和 tt:* 流程抢主导权；只由 taotao 适配层按路径读取

deps.name: cc-skills-golang
deps.used_for: Go 规范与专项知识：code-style / error-handling / context / concurrency / testing / security / database / grpc / gopls / lint / troubleshooting 等 47 个

deps.name: humanizer-zh
deps.used_for: 中文文档去模板化表达

deps.name: trailofbits-skills
deps.used_for: differential-review（改动爆炸半径 + 未覆盖测试）/ insecure-defaults / static-analysis（semgrep）

claude_plugins.used_for: Claude Code 原生 LSP：定义跳转、引用、诊断
PR 级多 agent 置信度评审（可选，tt:cr --pr）

mcp_servers.name: notion
mcp_servers.used_for: 读取 Notion 上的 PRD

tools.name: golangci-lint
tools.used_for: lint（替代 dlinter 的代码质量部分）

tools.name: gosec
tools.used_for: 安全扫描；高危 → 门禁硬失败

tools.name: govulncheck
tools.used_for: 依赖漏洞（只报实际调用到的）；命中 → 门禁硬失败
